implementation_guidance.classification: independent reference-model guidance derived from the above observations
safe_projection: Require a present model and current effort, supported count > 1, and enum-case-sensitive membership.
Preserve supported input order and duplicates. Generate IDs from model.id and effort raw string.
Use first-match ID lookup, then compare to fresh current effort before invoking the owner.
Keep synthetic catalogs explicit. Screenshots do not establish a fixed set of six stops or actual available models.
Keep local selection state and backend acceptance separately represented.
